baseline.boundary: Standalone Release OS process start -> started log after real hotkey registration and tray/context initialization; excludes installed updater checks and automatic dashboard rendering.
baseline.clock: Cross-process wall-clock timestamps; no clock adjustment observed; not a stopwatch measurement of the child.
baseline.cold_limit: Retain first launch separately; subsequent runs use warm filesystem/OS caches. No reboot/cold-cache claim.
